describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of dirt and sparse grass. Its entire body except the back is covered in dense, shaggy brown fur that is darker on the legs and back and lighter tan on the muzzle, chest and flank. The head is bear-like with a black nose and small eyes, bearing a single long curved horn on the forehead and two small rounded ears. Four thick furry legs support the body and end in clawed paws, with a very short furry stub tail at the rear. Covering the dorsal surface from just behind the neck to above the tail is a large, highly glossy, dark reddish-brown to black segmented exoskeleton with overlapping plates and a raised shield over the shoulders.

describe.description: A stocky four-legged mammal with dense shaggy brown fur standing in right profile on a small patch of ground. The body, head, ears, legs, clawed paws and short stub tail are bear-like. The entire back from behind the shoulders to the rump is covered by a glossy dark reddish-brown segmented carapace with transverse bands and a flared lower edge with oval openings, with a larger smooth shield bearing two small pointed projections over the shoulders. A single long slender backward-curving ring-segmented dark horn rises from the center of the forehead.
